title: Chapter 141: Who Speaks First
html:
The sight of Wang Hailong’s group gave undeniable weight to Chen Ge’s warning.

“I’ve never heard of a Haunted House dividing its scenarios into levels, but the owner’s explanation sounds professional.”

“I know it is for our own good, but I still wish to try the scariest scenario.”

After some discussion, the visitors accepted the rules. Relieved, Chen Ge led Wang Hailong’s group to the same resting place the medical students had used. “How do you feel? Should we call a doctor?”

“Thanks, but we’re much better.” Wang Hailong’s lips were purple, his face bloodless, and his unfocused eyes glazed with tears.

“You’re conscious enough to speak, so you must be fine.” Chen Ge crouched beside him. “You were lucky. The previous challenger is still hospitalized.”

Brother Long flashed a bitter smile. “Are you trying to console me?”

“I’m just telling you the truth.” Chen Ge took the nametags away from them and turned to tell Uncle Xu, “Let’s go.”

The familiar scene made Uncle Xu consider building a rest area beside the Haunted House. Visitors lying on the ground damaged the park’s image. Though initially furious, he had to admit Chen Ge’s tier system made sense; it should reduce the number of people fainting.

After personally confirming that the group was safe, he followed Chen Ge.

“Xiao Chen, did you plan all this? Are you certain about dividing the scenarios by level? It may increase revenue, but you could lose potential customers.”

“It has to happen.” Chen Ge stood firm. “The rules protect visitors. More scenarios are coming, and some will be too intense for ordinary people.”

“If they’re too intense, why not tone them down? The goal is to serve the majority.” Uncle Xu’s reasoning was sound, if conservative.

“Some things can’t be toned down. You’ll understand eventually.” After walking a short distance, Chen Ge remembered something. “Uncle Xu, does the park have spare surveillance cameras in storage?”

“We have some spare ones but not many. Why?”

“I want to install several in the underground garage. The new scenario has no surveillance, and that worries me.”

“Borrow surveillance equipment? How do you think of these things?” Uncle Xu shrugged. “We can’t lend it, but we might sell it to you at a used price. I need permission before touching anything in storage, so I’ll ask Director Luo this afternoon. Your Haunted House could become the park’s leading attraction. He’ll probably agree.”

Back at the Haunted House, Uncle Xu resumed ticket sales while Chen Ge reset the name tags, then entered Murder by Midnight as its killer. Several groups challenged Mu Yang High School, but most would not enter the sealed classroom. Since only wooden boards blocked the exit, frightened visitors could leave at any time. Few possessed Wang Hailong’s reckless courage, and no further incidents occurred.

At lunch, Chen Ge removed his costume and stepped outside as Wang Hailong and his brother approached. “Still here? Want another attempt?”

He was joking, but both brothers shook their heads violently. “No. We behaved rashly this morning. I hope you’ll forgive us.”

“Your tone has changed completely. What do you want?” Chen Ge was not naive enough to miss their motive.

Normally direct, Wang Hailong suddenly looked embarrassed. “Wenlong and I have a younger brother named Wang Shenglong. Until age five, he was playful and ordinary. Then he suddenly stopped speaking. Our father tried doctors and even fortune-tellers, but nothing helped.”

“What does that have to do with me?” Chen Ge could not see the connection.

“To make a long story short…” Wang Hailong checked that no one was listening and leaned closer. “Boss, I saw a terrifying girl in your Haunted House. She hung behind me with her feet on my shoulders. It was exactly what my brother described the night before he lost his voice.”

Wang Wenlong leaned in too. “It’s true. We were all sleeping in one room. After midnight, Shenglong sat up and said someone was standing on his shoulders. He begged us to remove them. We thought he was playing, but the next morning, he could no longer form a sentence.”

Touching his shoulder, Wang Hailong continued in a trembling voice. “Afterward, he communicated by writing. What he wrote was terrifying. That night, he saw someone beyond the courtyard wall staring at him. Then the person entered the house.”

“That’s scary?” Chen Ge had experienced worse.

“We lived in a village, and our courtyard wall was two and a half meters tall. Anyone looking over it had to be at least 2.6 meters.”

“Is that even a person anymore?”

“Exactly. Worse, the person entered effortlessly and asked Shenglong to play a game. If he refused, it would take something from him.”

“Did your brother reject the person? His voice was taken away?” Chen Ge guessed.

“No. Shenglong agreed. The game was called Who Speaks First. Once he nodded, the monster climbed onto his shoulders and became even taller.”
